<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>package_private</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1784056_sixscape.schedule_for_profile_sync</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description/><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>schedule_for_profile_sync</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var ScheduleForProfileSync = Class.create();
ScheduleForProfileSync.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {},

    /**
     * Main method to trigger profile synchronization.
     */
    syncProfiles: function() {
        try {
            var authToken = this._getAuthToken();
            if (!authToken) {
                throw new Error('Failed to retrieve authentication token.');
            }

            var existingProfiles = this._getExistingProfiles();

            var endpoint = this._getBaseEndpoint();
            var midServer = gs.getProperty('x_1784056_sixscape.Mid Server Name');

            var restMessage = this._createRestMessage(midServer);

            var profileIds = this._fetchActiveProfileIds(restMessage, authToken, endpoint);

            this._processProfiles(profileIds, restMessage, authToken, endpoint, existingProfiles);

            this._cleanupDeletedProfiles(existingProfiles);

            gs.info('Profile synchronization completed successfully.');

        } catch (ex) {
            gs.error('Error in ScheduleForProfileSync.syncProfiles: ' + ex.message);
            throw ex;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Retrieves the authentication token from the token provider.
     * @returns {string} Bearer token string or null if failed.
     */
    _getAuthToken: function() {
        var tokenObj = new get_token();
        var response = tokenObj.TestConnection();

        if (!response || response.length < 2) {
            gs.error('Invalid response from Token API.');
            return null;
        }

        var status = response[0];
        var responseBody = response[1];

        if (status !== 200) {
            gs.error('Token API returned status: ' + status);
            return null;
        }

        try {
            var parsed = JSON.parse(responseBody);
            return 'Bearer ' + parsed.authToken;
        } catch (e) {
            gs.error('Failed to parse token response: ' + e.message);
            return null;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Retrieves existing profiles from the local table in "profileId|profileName" format.
     * @returns {Array} List of existing profile identifiers.
     */
    _getExistingProfiles: function() {
        var profiles = [];
        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_1784056_sixscape_profile');
        gr.query();
        while (gr.next()) {
            var key = gr.getValue('profile_id') + '|' + gr.getValue('profile_name');
            profiles.push(key);
        }
        return profiles;
    },

    /**
     * Returns the cleaned base endpoint URL from system properties.
     * @returns {string} Base endpoint URL without trailing slash.
     */
    _getBaseEndpoint: function() {
        var endpoint = gs.getProperty('x_1784056_sixscape.End Point') || '';
        if (endpoint.endsWith('/')) {
            endpoint = endpoint.substring(0, endpoint.length - 1);
        }
        return endpoint;
    },

    /**
     * Creates and configures a RESTMessageV2 object, optionally with MID Server.
     * @param {string} midServerName MID Server name from properties.
     * @returns {sn_ws.RESTMessageV2} Configured RESTMessageV2 instance.
     */
    _createRestMessage: function(midServerName) {
        var r = new sn_ws.RESTMessageV2();
        if (midServerName && midServerName.trim() !== '') {
            r.setMIDServer(midServerName);
            r.setEccParameter('skip_sensor', 'true');
        }
        return r;
    },

    /**
     * Fetches all active profile IDs from the external API using pagination.
     * @param {sn_ws.RESTMessageV2} restMessage REST message object.
     * @param {string} authToken Authorization token.
     * @param {string} baseEndpoint Base API endpoint.
     * @returns {Array} List of profile IDs.
     */
    _fetchActiveProfileIds: function(restMessage, authToken, baseEndpoint) {
        var skip = 0;
        var top = 1;
        var profileIds = [];

        while (true) {
            restMessage.setHttpMethod('get');
            restMessage.setRequestHeader('Authorization', authToken);
            restMessage.setRequestHeader('User-Agent', 'snow');
            restMessage.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
            restMessage.setEndpoint(baseEndpoint + '/v1/profile');
            restMessage.setQueryParameter('status', 'eq Active');
            restMessage.setQueryParameter('$skip', skip);
            restMessage.setQueryParameter('$top', top);
            restMessage.setHttpTimeout(30000);

            var response = restMessage.execute();
            if (response.haveError()) {
                this._handleRestError(response);
            }

            var body = JSON.parse(response.getBody());
            for (var i = 0; i < body.length; i++) {
                profileIds.push(body[i].id);
            }

            if (body.length !== top) {
                break;
            }
            skip += top;
        }

        return profileIds;
    },

    /**
     * Processes each profile by fetching details, updating/inserting local records,
     * and handling profile group assignments.
     * @param {Array} profileIds List of profile IDs to process.
     * @param {sn_ws.RESTMessageV2} restMessage REST message object.
     * @param {string} authToken Authorization token.
     * @param {string} baseEndpoint Base API endpoint.
     * @param {Array} existingProfiles List of existing profiles to track deletions.
     */
    _processProfiles: function(profileIds, restMessage, authToken, baseEndpoint, existingProfiles) {
        for (var i = 0; i < profileIds.length; i++) {
            var profileId = profileIds[i];

            // Fetch profile details
            var profile = this._fetchProfileDetails(restMessage, authToken, baseEndpoint, profileId);

            // Fetch profile group assignment
            var profileGroupId = this._fetchProfileGroupId(restMessage, authToken, baseEndpoint, profile.name);

            // Upsert profile record
            this._upsertProfileRecord(profile, profileGroupId, existingProfiles);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Fetches detailed profile information by profile ID.
     * @param {sn_ws.RESTMessageV2} restMessage REST message object.
     * @param {string} authToken Authorization token.
     * @param {string} baseEndpoint Base API endpoint.
     * @param {string} profileId Profile ID.
     * @returns {Object} Parsed profile details.
     */
    _fetchProfileDetails: function(restMessage, authToken, baseEndpoint, profileId) {
        restMessage.setHttpMethod('get');
        restMessage.setRequestHeader('Authorization', authToken);
        restMessage.setRequestHeader('User-Agent', 'snow');
        restMessage.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        restMessage.setEndpoint(baseEndpoint + '/v1/profile/' + profileId);
        restMessage.setHttpTimeout(30000);

        var response = restMessage.execute();
        if (response.haveError()) {
            this._handleRestError(response);
        }

        return JSON.parse(response.getBody());
    },

    /**
     * Fetches the profile group ID by searching with profile name + "_devices".
     * @param {sn_ws.RESTMessageV2} restMessage REST message object.
     * @param {string} authToken Authorization token.
     * @param {string} baseEndpoint Base API endpoint.
     * @param {string} profileName Profile name.
     * @returns {string|null} Profile group ID or null if not found.
     */
    _fetchProfileGroupId: function(restMessage, authToken, baseEndpoint, profileName) {
        var groupName = profileName + '_devices';
        var baseSearchEndpoint = baseEndpoint + '/v1/search';

        var entityType = 'eq GROUP';
        var query = 'sw ' + groupName;
        var subfilter = '(entityName=sw ' + groupName + ' $or entityId=sw ' + groupName + ')';

        // Construct full URL with encoded query parameters
        var fullUrl = baseSearchEndpoint +
            '?entityType=' + encodeURIComponent(entityType) +
            '&query=' + encodeURIComponent(query) +
            '&$subfilter=' + encodeURIComponent(subfilter);

        restMessage.setHttpMethod('get');
        restMessage.setRequestHeader('Authorization', authToken);
        restMessage.setRequestHeader('User-Agent', 'snow');
        restMessage.setRequestHeader('Content-Type', 'application/json');
        restMessage.setEndpoint(fullUrl);
        restMessage.setHttpTimeout(30000);

        var response = restMessage.execute();
        if (response.haveError()) {
            this._handleRestError(response);
        }

        var body = JSON.parse(response.getBody());
        if (body && body.length > 0) {
            return body[0].entityId || null;
        }
        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Inserts or updates a profile record in the local table.
     * @param {Object} profile Profile details object.
     * @param {string|null} profileGroupId Profile group ID.
     * @param {Array} existingProfiles List of existing profiles to track deletions.
     */
    _upsertProfileRecord: function(profile, profileGroupId, existingProfiles) {
        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_1784056_sixscape_profile');
        gr.addQuery('profile_id', profile.id);
        gr.query();

        if (gr.hasNext()) {
            while (gr.next()) {
                this._updateProfileRecord(gr, profile, profileGroupId);
            }
            // Remove from existingProfiles list to track deletions
            var key = profile.id + '|' + profile.name;
            var index = existingProfiles.indexOf(key);
            if (index !== -1) {
                existingProfiles.splice(index, 1);
            }
        } else {
            this._insertProfileRecord(profile, profileGroupId);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Updates an existing profile record.
     * @param {GlideRecord} gr GlideRecord of the profile.
     * @param {Object} profile Profile details.
     * @param {string|null} profileGroupId Profile group ID.
     */
    _updateProfileRecord: function(gr, profile, profileGroupId) {
        gr.profile_name = profile.name;
        gr.profile_id = profile.id;
        gr.cert_type = profile.certType;
        gr.product_code = profile.management.productCode;
        gr.key_algorithm = profile.management.keyAlgorithm;
        gr.hash_algorithm = profile.management.hashAlgorithm;
        gr.validity = profile.management.validity;
        gr.renewal_threshold = profile.management.renewalThreshold;
        gr.profile_status = profile.status;
        gr.profile_group_id = profileGroupId;
        gr.update();
    },

    /**
     * Inserts a new profile record.
     * @param {Object} profile Profile details.
     * @param {string|null} profileGroupId Profile group ID.
     */
    _insertProfileRecord: function(profile, profileGroupId) {
        var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_1784056_sixscape_profile');
        gr.initialize();
        gr.profile_name = profile.name;
        gr.profile_id = profile.id;
        gr.cert_type = profile.certType;
        gr.product_code = profile.management.productCode;
        gr.key_algorithm = profile.management.keyAlgorithm;
        gr.hash_algorithm = profile.management.hashAlgorithm;
        gr.validity = profile.management.validity;
        gr.renewal_threshold = profile.management.renewalThreshold;
        gr.profile_status = profile.status;
        gr.profile_group_id = profileGroupId;
        gr.insert();
    },

    /**
     * Deletes profiles from the local table that no longer exist in the external system.
     * @param {Array} existingProfiles List of profile keys remaining after processing.
     */
    _cleanupDeletedProfiles: function(existingProfiles) {
        for (var i = 0; i < existingProfiles.length; i++) {
            var key = existingProfiles[i];
            if (!key) continue;

            var parts = key.split('|');
            if (parts.length !== 2) continue;

            var profileId = parts[0];
            var profileName = parts[1];

            var gr = new GlideRecordSecure('x_1784056_sixscape_profile');
            gr.addQuery('profile_id', profileId);
            gr.addQuery('profile_name', profileName);
            gr.query();

            while (gr.next()) {
                gr.deleteRecord();
                gs.info('Deleted profile: ' + profileId + ' | ' + profileName);
            }
        }
    },

    /**
     * Handles REST API errors by parsing and throwing meaningful messages.
     * @param {sn_ws.RESTResponseV2} response REST response object.
     * @throws {Error} Throws error with message from response.
     */
    _handleRestError: function(response) {
        var responseBody = response.getBody();
        var message = 'Unknown REST API error';
        try {
            var res = JSON.parse(responseBody);
            message = res.title || message;
        } catch (e) {
            message = responseBody;
        }
        throw new Error(message);
    },

    type: 'ScheduleForProfileSync'
};
]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2025-07-10 07:45:03</sys_created_on><sys_id>de601497c32ee21087613342b401314a</sys_id><sys_mod_count>30</sys_mod_count><sys_name>schedule_for_profile_sync</sys_name><sys_package display_value="Sixscape IDcentral" source="x_1784056_sixscape">42bb04c3c3a6a21087613342b40131c0</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="Sixscape IDcentral">42bb04c3c3a6a21087613342b40131c0</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_de601497c32ee21087613342b401314a</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2025-07-10 10:44:06</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
